Practised position words: top/bottom, inside/outside, and near/far.
Practised using inside/outside for containers in three attempts; unaided correct responses were not yet shown.
Shaurya sometimes placed an object on top and called it inside when it touched the container.
The top-versus-inside mix-up was still present at the end; check again with clear object-and-container examples next time.
end.parentNote: Asha practised position words with Shaurya using containers, including whether an object is inside or outside. Shaurya tried examples such as water inside and a fish outside, but the “on top” and “inside” meanings were still mixed up at the end, so this was not yet corrected. At home, place a toy in a box, on the box, and beside the box, and ask, “Where is it?” each time.
